comparison.objective: PR-2077 transfers four instruments onto a sterile field without contamination; the candidate adjusts and locks robot hardware.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2077 tests collision-free carrying, placement within a sterile boundary, spacing, and contamination-aware hand use, not threaded torque control.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2077 requires all instruments flat, separated, sterile, released, and still; the candidate requires angular accuracy, locking, retained cycles, and tool clearance.
comparison.reason: Sterility-preserving placement tests contact avoidance rather than mechanical calibration.
